source: Chapter 670: Sudden Arrival
target: Capitulum 670: Subitus Adventus

source: Translator: CKtalon
target: Interpretator: CKtalon

source: Amidst the dizzying sensation that threatened to separate his spirit from his body, Lumian saw trees that seemed to slumber in the darkness and a pitch‑black boulder…
target: Inter sensum vertiginosum, qui animam eius a corpore separare minabatur, Lumian vidit arbores, quae in tenebris dormire videbantur, et lapidem atrum…

source: Finally, he removed the brown glasses from his nose and arched his back slightly to alleviate the discomfort.
target: Denique, oculos fuscos a naso abstulit et paulo dorsum arcuit ad levandum molestiam.

source: Even an Ascetic wouldn’t be able to use the Mystery Prying Glasses for long.
target: Etiam asceticus non poterat diu uti Speculis Inquirendis Mysterii.

source: Of course, this ensured his safety to a certain degree.
target: Certe, hoc ad certum modum salutem eius confirmavit.

source: Through this “prying,” Lumian confirmed two things.
target: Per hanc indagationem, Lumian duas res comprobavit.

source: First, the area beneath Hisoka’s house was indeed unusual, but it seemed more like an illusory symbol than an actual entity.
target: Primum, spatium sub domo Hisoka vere inusitatum erat, sed videbatur magis ut symbolum illusorium quam verae entitatis.

source: It indicated that this place had once been corrupted or influenced, with the most severe occurrence taking place underground.
target: Indicabat hunc locum olim corruptum aut affictum fuisse, cum gravissima evenisset sub terra.

source: Second, this influence was connected to the black boulder deep within the primitive forest.
target: Secundo, haec influentia ad lapidem atrum, profundo in silva primitiva, pertinere videbatur.

source: "How did it go?" Maslow, his face painted white, asked.
target: "Quomodo processit?" inquit Maslow, cuius facies albo picta erat.

source: Lumian stored the Mystery Prying Glasses back into his Traveler’s Bag and smiled.
target: Lumian Specula Perscrutanda Mysterii in sacculo Viatoris recondidit et subridens fiebat.

source: “The abnormality I ‘saw’ here originates from a black boulder deep in the primitive forest. Have you ever seen or heard of that black boulder?”
target: "Anomalia, quam hic 'vidi,' orta est ex lapide atro, profunde in silva primitiva. Numquamne vidistis aut audistis de eo lapide atro?"

source: The pale‑white Reaza and Maslow, his black hair falling over his shoulders, shook their heads in unison, indicating a negative answer.
target: Reaza pallido‑albo et Maslow, cujus capilli nigri super humeros cadebant, capita simul concussere, responsum negativum indicantes.

source: Lumian wasn’t in a rush to do the second thing he had planned for the night.
target: Lumian non festinabat secunda re, quam pro nocte destinaverat, exsequi.

source: He glanced at Reaza, who was wearing a thin formal suit and appeared to be a mix of Intisian and West Balam heritage.
target: Ad Reaza intuebatur, qui vestimenta formalia tenuia gerebat et ex mixtione gentium Intisianae et Occidentalis Balam appareret.

source: He casually said, “I thought that with your arrival, some people in Tizamo would gradually leave and stay in Port Pylos for a while.
target: Levis mente inquit: "Putabam adventu vestro, aliquos in Tizamo homines paulatim discedere et in Portu Pylos aliquantulum manere."

source: “As you know, the Dream Festival should start within three days.”
target: "Ut scitis, Festival Somniorum intra tres dies incipere debet."

source: Reaza calmly replied, “Based on my experience, except for those who have only arrived in Tizamo in the past two weeks, it’s best not to leave this place and go elsewhere to prevent any abnormalities from spreading.
target: Reaza tranquillime respondit: "Ex mea experientia, nisi pro iis qui intra duas hebdomadas solum in Tizamo advenerunt, optime est hunc locum non relinquere et alibi se non conferre, ne qua anomalia diffundatur.

source: It should only be considered after the Dream Festival ends and the primitive tribe launches another attack.”
target: Illud solum considerandum est post Festival Somniorum finitum esse et tribus primitiva iterum impetum facere.

source: Very standardized process… I thought you would consider the opinions of Intis, Feynapotter, and other Northern Continent countries, allowing people with corresponding nationalities to evacuate in advance and protect them.
target: Processus haec valde ordinatus est… putabam te opiniones Intis, Feynapotter, et aliarum nationum Continenti Septentrionalis consideraturum esse, ut homines nationalitatibus congruentes praevius evacuari possint atque protegerentur.

source: For example, the owners of the plantations outside the city and their families…
target: Exempli gratia, domini plantarum extra urbem et eorum familiae…

source: Yes, this is likely because the Dream Festival has never shown direct harm.
target: Ita, verisimiliter id, quia Festival Somniorum umquam damnum directe non ostendit.

source: It only caused some townsfolk to suffer from hysteria and attracted an attack from the forests primitive tribe.
target: Solum fecit ut quidam incolae urbis perturbatione laborarent et impetum a tribu silvarum primitivarum adduceret.

source: The first situation could be resolved by a simple Mass.
target: Prima res simplici Missa solvi poterat.

source: The second problem could be guarded against and fended off…
target: Secunda quaestio repellenda et defendenda poterat.

source: Lumian roughly understood the mentality of Admiral Querarill and the patrol team’s leaders.
target: Lumian paene intellexit mentem Admiralis Querarill et duces turmae praesidiariae.

source: Since there wouldn’t be any major issues, they would act as if the Dream Festival didn’t exist, merely advising the local official Beyonders to be vigilant and guard against any mishaps while hoping that the Church of The Fool could resolve the hidden dangers!
target: Cum nullae sentiri videbantur quaestiones graves, agerent ut Festival Somniorum non existeret; solum officiali locali Beyonders consilium dabant ut vigiles essent et casus adversos praevenirent, sperantes Ecclesiam Stulti pericula occulta solvere!

source: If they were to do more, they might trigger something and worsen the situation.
target: Si plura facerent, aliquid excitaretur atque res deterioraretur.

source: After discussing the matter, Lumian recovered from the discomfort caused by the Mystery Prying Glasses.
target: Postquam rem disseruit, Lumian molestiam, quae Specula Perscrutanda Mysterii causa erat, superare coepit.

source: He took out the unique Eye of Truth and placed it in front of his face.
target: Eduxit Unicum Oculum Veritatis et ante faciem suam posuit.

source: The relatively handsome Southern Continent native’s eyelids twitched at the sight of the pale‑white flesh, dark blood vessel‑like earmuff and spectacle temple, as well as the blood‑colored lens intertwined with transparent purple tubes.
target: Palpebrae indigenī Continentis Meridionalis, relativè formosi, micabant ad conspectum carnis pallide albae, auriculorum quasi vasorum sanguineorum obscurorum, templa speculi, necnon lentis sanguineae, cum tubis purpureis transparentibus implicatis.

source: How many glasses does Louis Berry own?
target: Quot oculos habet Louis Berry?

source: Moreover, each one is a mystical item!
target: Praeterea, quisque eorum item mysticum est!

source: After donning the single‑lens Eye of Truth, Lumian surveyed his surroundings, seeking to uncover the truth behind reality.
target: Postquam Unicum Oculum Veritatis indutus est, Lumian circumspiciebat, veritatem post realitatem detegere intendens.

source: As he did so, a voice gradually sounded in his ears, growing louder and more chaotic.
target: Dum id faciebat, vox paulatim in auribus eius resonare coepit, crescente strepitu et turbatione.

source: Each note and word seemed to materialize, flooding into Lumian’s mind.
target: Quisque nota et verbum apparere videbantur, inundantes mentem Lumiani.

source: It made him feel as if his head was rapidly expanding like a balloon.
target: Eum faciebat sentire quasi caput eius, ut globus, celeriter expandi.

source: If the balloon continued to expand, there would only be one outcome: bursting with a resounding bang!
target: Si globus ultra expandi pergeret, unicum exitum esset: ruptio cum strepitu ingenti!

source: Lumian reached for his ear, ready to remove the Eye of Truth at any moment.
target: Lumian ad aurem se extendit, paratus ad Oculum Veritatis extrahendum quolibet momento.

source: He seized the opportunity to scrutinize Hisoka’s house.
target: Illud occasum cepit ut domum Hisoka perscrutaret.

source: He believed that it was safer to take the risk of prying into the house’s secrets before the Dream Festival, while not inside the special dream.
target: Existimabat tutius esse periculum subeundi in arcana domus perscrutanda ante Festival Somniorum, quam intra somnium speciale versari.

source: It was safer than using the Eye of Truth and Mystery Prying Glasses within the dream itself.
target: Tutior erat quam uti Oculo Veritatis et Speculis Perscrutandis Mysterii intra ipsum somnium.

source: Through the purple lens, Lumian couldn’t discern much of the truth.
target: Per lentem purpuream, Lumian multum veritatis distinguere non potuit.

source: Everything appeared similar to what he could see with his naked eye, but the night seemed even darker.
target: Omnia similia videbantur ad ea, quae nudo oculo videre poterat, sed nox etiam obscurior videbatur.

source: Without hesitation, his eye bulged, and blood vessels appeared on his body.
target: Sine mora, oculus eius protuberavit, et vasa sanguinea in corpore eius apparuerunt.

source: He abruptly removed the Eye of Truth, and a slightly sharp explosion reverberated in his ears.
target: Subito Oculum Veritatis abstulit, et parva acuta explosio in auribus eius reverberavit.

source: Phew, phew… Panting heavily, Lumian’s mind was in disarray, overwhelmed by a barrage of strange knowledge. He couldn’t think straight.
target: Pheu, pheu… Graviter anhelans, mens Lumiani in perturbatione erat, superata multitudine cognitionum mirarum. Recte cogitare non poterat.

source: At that moment, even if someone were to ambush him, he wouldn’t be able to react quickly.
target: In illo momento, etiam si quis eum insideret, celeriter agere non posset.

source: After more than ten seconds, Lumian finally regained his ability to think clearly.
target: Post plus quam decem secundas, Lumian tandem facultatem recte cogitandi recuperavit.

source: He instinctively organized the knowledge that had been forcefully injected into his mind.
target: Instincte disposuit scientiam, quae vi in mentem eius infusa fuerat.

source: “The art of sophistry…
target: Ars sophisticae…

source: “How to cultivate superior wheat seeds…
target: Quomodo semina tritici superiora colenda sint…

source: “Canning techniques…
target: Technicae conservandi…

source: “How to roast pork that’s crispy on the outside and tender on the inside…
target: Quomodo porcinam tostum, quae exterius croccus et intus tener est, praeparare…

source: “Music to soothe a sow’s emotions…
target: Musica ad molliendos affectus porcae…

source: “The Revelation of Evernight…
target: Revelatio Noctis Aeternae…

source: “Favorite Positions of Celebrities—Memoirs of Those Mistresses”
target: Positiones Praedilectae Celebritatum — Memorabilia Illarum Concubinarum

source: Whats all this nonsense? Can’t there be any useful knowledge?
target: Quid est haec omne ineptia?

source: In the past, although Aurore had been tormented by the Hidden Sage’s instillation of knowledge, she had at least stumbled upon valuable mysticism insights.
target: Olim, quamquam Aurore infusione scientiae a Sapiensi Occulti vexata erat, saltem pretiosas notiones mysticae invenit.

source: Wait, had she also been corrupted by such knowledge?
target: Exspecta, num etiam ipsa tali scientia corrupta fuerat?

source: Is that why she always portrays a rich theoretical understanding in her books…
target: An hoc est cur semper in libris suis opulentam theoreticam intellegentiam ostendat?

source: Lumian rubbed his still throbbing head and said to Reaza and Maslow, “I’m going to the edge of the forest to take a look. Do you want to come with me?”
target: Lumian caput suum adhuc pulsantem fregit et ad Reaza et Maslow dixit: "Ad limitem silvae spectare ibo. Visne mecum venire?"

source: Reaza nodded, stingy with his words, while Maslow made his stance clear by walking towards the stairs.
target: Reaza annuit paucis verbis, dum Maslow consilium suum clarum faciens ambulavit ad scalas.

source: If Camus were here, he would undoubtedly smile wryly and say, “Do I have a choice?” Lumian mused to himself.
target: Si Camus hic fuisset, indubitanter subridens diceret: "Habesne mihi electionem?" meditatus est Lumian sibi.

source: He left Hisoka’s house and made his way towards the primitive forest near Tizamo Town.
target: Domum Hisokae reliquit et iter cepit ad silvam primitivam iuxta oppidum Tizamo.

source: After crossing the intersection and arriving at another street, Lumian noticed a four‑wheeled, four‑seater carriage parked at the entrance of the Brieu Motel.
target: Postquam angulum transivit et ad aliam viam pervenit, Lumian animadvertit carrucam quattuor rotarum, quattuor sedentarum, ad introitum Brieu Motel positam.

source: An attendant and a lady’s maid stepped out of the carriage, carrying their luggage, and followed a man and a woman towards the motel.
target: Unus minister et ancilla, sarcinas ferentes, e carruca exierunt et virum feminamque ad motel secuti sunt.

source: The man was attired in a dark‑gray formal suit and a half top hat.
target: Vir in veste formali grisea obscura indutus erat et pileum dimidiatum gerebat.

source: His complexion resembled that of someone from the Northern Continent, and his side profile was well‑defined, with striking dark green eyes.
target: Eius cutis similis erat illius ex Continente Septentrionali, et profilum laterale bene definitum habebat, cum oculis viridissimis obscuris eminens.

source: The woman wore a light‑colored dress that allowed for ease of movement and a feathered hat adorned with pearls.
target: Femina vestem levem coloris gerebat, quae motui facilitatem praebebat, et pileum pennatum, margaritis ornatum, gerebat.

source: She appeared to be in her late twenties, and her skin was delicate and radiant.
target: Videbatur in annis vicesimis, et cutis eius delicata atque splendida erat.

source: One would easily determine that she was a beauty just from glimpsing her side profile.
target: Facile cognosceretur eam pulchram esse, ex solo aspectu profili lateralis.

source: Lumian averted his gaze and turned to Reaza and Maslow.
target: Lumian conspectum avertit et ad Reaza et Maslow se convertit.

source: "Is it the weekend?”
target: "Estne hoc finem hebdomadis?"

source: "No,” Maslow replied, understanding the implication behind Louis Berry’s question.
target: "Non," respondit Maslow, intellegens implicationem quaestionis a Louis Berry.

source: "Gentlemen and ladies often find time to hunt in Tizamo, not just on weekends.”
target: Domini et dominae saepe tempus ad venandum in Tizamo inveniunt, non solum in finibus hebdomadis.

source: Lumian turned to Reaza and inquired, “You didn’t seal off this area?”
target: Lumian ad Reaza conversus quaesivit: "Nonne hunc locum obclusisti?"

source: “That would only cause unnecessary panic,” Reaza responded succinctly.
target: "Hoc tantum inutilem formidinem moveret," respondit Reaza succincte.

source: Lumian didn’t press the matter further.
target: Lumian rem non ulterius persecutus est.

source: He walked out of the town through the Brieu Motel and ventured into the primitive forest.
target: Ex urbe per Brieu Motel egreditur et in silvam primitivam se immisit.

source: He delved deeper along the path he had become familiar with from the dream.
target: In via quam ex somnio notaverat, se ulterius immisit.

source: Finally, he arrived at the chaotic zone in reality, where various dream fragments intertwined.
target: Denique ad zonam tumultuosam in re pervenit, ubi varia fragmenta somniorum inter se implicata erant.

source: It was an unremarkable place, indistinguishable from its surroundings.
target: Locus erat mediocris, non distinctus ab circumstantibus suis.

source: Lumian found a palm tree and sat down.
target: Lumian palmam invenit et consedit.

source: He turned to Reaza and Maslow and said, “Keep an eye on my surroundings. I’m going to sleep here.”
target: Ad Reaza et Maslow conversus, dixit: "Conspicite circumstantias meas. Hic dormiturus sum."

source: He wanted to see what would happen if he fell asleep closer to the source of the abnormality, if he could enter that peculiar dream, and in what state.
target: Volebat videre quid accideret, si propius ad fontem anomaliae obdormiret, si in istum somnium peculiarem introire posset, et in quo statu esset.

source: Receiving affirmative responses from the two patrol team members, Lumian closed his eyes and attempted Cogitation.
target: Accipientes responsa affirmativa a duobus membris turmae praesidiariae, Lumian oculos clausit et cogitare conatus est.

source: At some point, he drifted off to sleep.
target: Aliquando obdormivit.

source: After an unknown period, he awoke.
target: Post tempus ignotum, experrectus est.

source: Catching sight of Reaza and Maslow, Lumian rose to his feet and nodded thoughtfully.
target: Reaza et Maslow conspectos, Lumian surrexit et cogitabunde annuit.

source: This place doesn’t work either… Is Hisoka’s house the only effective location?
target: Hic locus quoque non operatur… Estne domus Hisoka sola locus efficax?

source: Or should I find that black boulder and sleep near it?
target: An debeam illum lapidem atrum invenire et prope dormire?

source: Lumian gazed into the pitch‑black forest, contemplating for a few moments before turning to Reaza and Maslow.
target: Lumian in silvam atrum intuebatur, aliquot momenta meditans, deinde ad Reaza et Maslow se vertit.

source: “Let’s head back.”
target: "Redeamus."

source: The trio swiftly returned to Tizamo.
target: Trio celeriter ad Tizamo redierunt.

source: The late night had settled in, and the streets were devoid of any passersby.
target: Nox sero iam consedit, et plateae nullis transeuntibus erant.

source: No lights or sounds emanated from the houses on either side.
target: Nec luminaria neque soni ex domibus utrimque emanabant.

source: Occasionally, the snorts of livestock on the ground floor of the buildings could be heard, accentuating the pervading darkness and silence.
target: Interdum, sufflatus pecorum in plano primo aedificiorum audiebantur, accentuantes pervadas tenebras ac silentium.

source: The dim crimson moon’s light seemed to emphasize the depths of the darkness.
target: Lumen lunaris rubri tenuum videbatur profunditates tenebrarum sublineare.

source: On this dark night, Lumian walked along a muddy road, heading towards the Brieu Motel situated deep within the street.
target: In hac nocte obscura, Lumian per viam lutosam ambulabat, versus Brieu Motel, quod penitus in via situm erat.

source: Reaza and Maslow followed quietly behind him.
target: Reaza et Maslow silentiose post eum secuti sunt.

source: Suddenly, Lumian’s mind spun, and his vision momentarily blurred before clearing.
target: Subito, mens Lumiani vertiginem sensit, et visio eius momento offuscata, antequam dissoluta esset.

source: This is… His pupils dilated as he instinctively scanned his surroundings but found nothing amiss.
target: Hoc est… Pupillae eius dilatatae erant, dum instinctive circumspiciebat, sed nihil inusitatum reperit.

source: At that moment, in a vacant house on the ground floor diagonally ahead, a dim candlelight illuminated a room on the third floor.
target: In illo momento, in domo vacua in plano primo, diagonaliter ante, lumen candelae tenuum illustravit conclave in tertio plano.

source: Immediately after, glass windows on this street and throughout Tizamo Town were set aglow by the light of burning candles.
target: Statim postea, fenestrae vitreae in hac via et per urbem Tizamo lumine candelae ardentis fulserunt.

source: Rhea awoke to find that darkness had already descended, but the candles in many houses continued to burn.
target: Rhea experrecta invenit tenebras iam descendisse, sed in multis domibus candelae adhuc ardebant.

source: This indicated that it wasn’t too late.
target: Hoc indicabat nondum sero esse.

source: Feeling lazy, Rhea had no desire to prepare her own food.
target: Pigritia affecta, Rhea proprium cibum praeparare non voluit.

source: Carrying her bow and arrows, she left the room and exited the police headquarters from the side, making her way towards the nearby Bunia cafe.
target: Arcum et sagittas portans, conclave reliquit et ex praefectura vigilarum egreditur, versus cauponam Bunia prope contendens.

source: The streets were nearly deserted, as they were every night.
target: Viae fere desertae erant, sicut solum in finibus hebdomadis.

source: Rhea glanced at the tables and chairs still scattered along the street and approached the kitchen counter.
target: Rhea tabulas et sellas adhuc per viam dispersas intuens ad mensam culinae accessit.

source: In Dutanese, she said to the busy cafe owner and waiter, Bunia, who had his head lowered, “A glass of Cosa and a beef burrito.”
target: In Dutanica, dixit ad Bunia, cauponae dominum et ministrum, qui caput demissum habebat: "Vitrum Cosa et burrito bubulo."

source: Bunia paused in the midst of washing cups and looked up.
target: Bunia inter poculas lavandas subsistit et sursum aspicit.

source: His naturally curly black hair gave him a mixed‑blood appearance.
target: Capilli eius, naturaliter crispati et nigri, eum speciem sanguinis mixti praebebant.

source: He looked at Rhea and revealed an obvious, strange smile that made Rhea inexplicably uneasy.
target: Bunia Rhea aspiciens risum insolitum ac notabilem ostendit, quod Rhea inexplicabiliter inquietam reddidit.

source: Rhea knew Bunia well and was aware that he was a shy, kind, and adult man who wasn’t particularly adept at communicating with women.
target: Rhea Buniam bene noverat et intellexit eum virum esse timidum, benignum, et adultum, qui non valde callens erat in feminis communicandis.

source: He had never smiled like this before.
target: Numquam antea ita subriserat.

source: Bunia fixed his gaze on Rhea and chuckled in a deep voice.
target: Bunia oculos suos in Rhea fixavit et voce profunda subridens risit.

source: “You’ve got big boobs…”
target: "Magnae mammae habes…"
